profile.headline: Quality Focused Solutions Architect
profile.summary: Versatile software developer with experience in various roles of the development life-cycle: Quality Assurance, Software Development, Business Analyst, and Scrum Master. Skilled in technical documentation, web development (Angular/C#), T-SQL, requirement writing, and project management.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Cross functional team member who manages back office (time entry, payroll, billing, etc.) feature projects for agile software development team. My primary responsibilities include: project management, feature workflow development, writing requirements and acceptance criteria, prioritizing back office feature requests, creating features for compliance needs, and feature development planning.

positions.title: Web Designer / Developer
positions.description:
• Design, develop, and maintain websites for all college units using Dreamweaver and CMS (Drupal) according to branding standards
• Evaluate and prioritize client requests
• Integrate dynamic features into websites (event/blog feeds, course feeds, etc.)
• Web image optimization using Photoshop CS6
• Process documentation creation and training

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
• Design event printed materials using Adobe Creative Suite
• Assist in event planning and hosting 
• Create and send monthly email newsletters

positions.title: Web Content Quality Assurance
positions.description:
• Systematically check web pages created by web content team for correct functionality and branding per client’s request
• Troubleshoot configuration issues using proprietary software
• Create training and process improvement documentation
